title: When the Pastor Runs Out of Words
description: In this humorous and authentic sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a series of hilarious and relatable anecdotes, weaving in scripture and spiritual insights along the way. From dental emergencies to midnight IHOP escapades, Pastor Chris shows how even in the midst of chaos, God's presence and power can be felt. Join us for a refreshing and uplifting message that will leave you laughing, praying, and praising the Lord.
